_readme: Single source of truth for the Eatfit site build. Run ./build.sh after any change. Keys starting with _ are notes, not used by the build. A null value means 'not supplied yet': the build leaves that field out of the page and out of structured data. See NEEDS-INPUT.md.

brand.name: Eatfit
brand._VERIFY_tagline: Site line kept as-is. Official tagline candidate 'Not just a meal - It's a Bowl' not adopted until confirmed. NEEDS-INPUT #B3.
brand.tagline: Healthy, yummy, honest and wholesome Indian food, made with real ingredients, zero trans fat and lots of love.
brand._VERIFY_hashtag: Site uses #HealthyMadeHappier; Instagram bio snapshot shows #BodySaysThanks. NEEDS-INPUT #B2.
brand._sameAs_note: Only verified official profiles. Add others (Facebook, LinkedIn, X, YouTube) only after the owner confirms the URL.
brand._VERIFY_sub_brands: Site shows 5; official announcement lists 8. Kept at 5 until the confirmed portfolio is supplied. NEEDS-INPUT #B4.

_cities_note: listed_on_site = the brand-owned city list shown on the site (VERIFY: site says 8, curefoods.in lists 9; NEEDS-INPUT #B1). order = links verified to land on an Eatfit page for that city; null = no verified link, so no button is shown. Verified 2026-10-25 on desktop web and mobile web (iPhone 13 emulation).
_ownly_note: Ownly has no web ordering. The Ownly link is the brand app link supplied by the owner: on a phone it opens an 'Open in Ownly' screen, on desktop it lands on Ownly's generic home page. It is labelled 'Ownly app' on the site. A per-city Eatfit Ownly URL is needed (NEEDS-INPUT #O1).

trust._note: Rendered only when all of rating, rating_count, rating_source and rating_as_of are supplied. Press items need title, outlet, url, date.

menu._note: last_changed = date the menu data (build/menu_live.tsv) last changed, not the build date. Update it whenever you refresh that file.
menu._dish_details_format: {"Dish name as shown": {"description": "...", "kcal": 0, "protein_g": 0, "price_inr": 0, "source": "who supplied it, date"}} - only verified values; missing keys stay hidden

order_links._note: Brand-level links supplied by the owner, used by every Order button. Swiggy direct opens the nearest Eatfit outlet on mobile web/app but lands on swiggy.com on desktop. Zomato onelink targets the app (desktop lands on zomato.com); owner to share a newer Zomato link. Ownly is app-only. Per-city links in cities[] are kept for llms.txt.
